4.1 Customer<sup>-</sup>Facing Website Pages
The diagram illustrates a website’s information architecture, divided into three main sections connected by directional arrows.

**Top-left section (blue-themed cluster):**
This group contains eight pages interconnected in a fully meshed network (each page links to every other). The pages are:
- Help & FAQ
- Privacy Policy
- Site Map
- Rings SEO Landing Page
- Terms of Use
- Event Schedule
- Safe Shopping Guarantee
- Auction Glossary

An arrow points from this entire blue cluster downward to the red cluster below and rightward to the green/orange/purple flowchart on the right.

**Bottom-left section (red-themed cluster):**
This group centers around a large red octagon labeled “Registration Page 1” at its top vertex.

Surrounding it are seven additional pages arranged radially:
- Registration Page 2 (top-right)
- My Account Page (right)
- Recently Ended Auctions (bottom-right)
- My Watch List (bottom-left)
- My Bid History (left)
- My Current Bids (top-left)

Additionally, branching off from “My Account Page” is a vertical stack of four sub-pages:
- My Account Edit Page 1
- My Account Edit Page 2
- My Account Edit Page 3
- My Account Edit Page 4

All surrounding pages connect directly to the central red octagon (“Registration Page 1”), forming a star-like topology. An arrow points upward from this red cluster to the blue cluster above.

The interface is divided into two main sections: “Administration Menu” on the left and “Reports Menu” on the right.

Under the **Administration Menu**, the following options are listed, each followed by a “GO ▶” button:
- Create New Auctions
- View / Edit Current or Scheduled Auctions
- Manage Global Settings
- Edit Auction Event Profiles
- SKU History
- Customer History
- User Access Management

Under the **Reports Menu**, the following reports are available, each also accompanied by a “GO ▶” button (except the last, which has a green “GO ▶” button):
- Status of Current Auctions
- Sales Report
- Competition Report
- RFM Report
- Customer Ranking Report
- Inventory Performance & Aging Report
- Omniture Reports
